subject: MAP Kickoff: Draft engagement calendar + dependency checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@novamed.com>, Devon Price <devon.price@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Draft engagement calendar + dependency checklist

Hi Avery / Devon —

Thanks again for the time on the call this morning. As promised, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short recap of discovery notes. The attached MAP is intentionally light — it focuses on the milestones we discussed, owners we suggested, and two timeline options so we can align on pace.

Key highlights from discovery (short):
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for clinical triage workflows (batch + streaming).
- Core must-haves: SSO (SAML), sample data pipeline (CSV -> secure S3), and SOC 2 evidence for data retention controls.
- Success metric: production latency <= 450ms p95 for 512-token requests; pilot NPS > 70 from internal reviewers.

Two timeline options (high-level):
- Option A — Accelerated pilot (6 weeks): engineering integration + 2-week validation window. Target close: 2027-01-28. Pros: faster time-to-value; cons: tight compliance window.
- Option B — Compliance-first (10 weeks): adds a formal evidence collection and 3-week internal validation. Target close: 2027-03-15. Pros: lower risk for your Compliance team.

Dependencies called out in the draft: SAML credentials, a 50–100 MB sample dataset (anonymized), and SOC 2 evidence exports (logs, retention policy).

Ask: Please reply with 1) preferred timeline (Option A or B or a hybrid), 2) confirmation of the Novamed stakeholders who should be on the MAP (names + email), and 3) any additional dependencies we missed.

Next internal steps on our side (proposed):
- Ben: own the integration smoke test and pre-demo checklist
- Karthik: update the master MAP spreadsheet and populate milestone owners/ETA
- Soojin: validate SOC 2 evidence list and call out any gaps

Attachments: map-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP tab + milestone grid), discovery-notes.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min follow-up if that helps.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@novamed.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Draft engagement calendar + dependency checklist

Marissa — thanks for this and for capturing the call so quickly. Helpful.

We reviewed the two options with our program manager and Compliance. Given the regulatory requirements we have to satisfy, we lean toward Option B (Compliance-first). A couple quick notes / asks:

- Can we shift the integration smoke test earlier (so our internal QA has two full weeks to validate before the formal validation window)? That would help us hit an earlier internal demo.
- Our Compliance team would like to target an earlier close if possible. If the integration test is moved up and evidence collection can be run in parallel, we could aim for 2027-03-04 as a target close instead of 2027-03-15. Is that feasible?
- Please add Jennifer Lee (jennifer.lee@novamed.com) — she is our engineering lead and should be the technical SME on the MAP.

Also: can you call out the exact SAML attributes you need? Our SSO team wants the list before they commit time.

Thanks — happy to sync with Ben on integration specifics.

Avery — great, thanks for the quick alignment and for adding Jennifer. We can absolutely run the integration smoke test earlier and aim for your suggested target close of 2027-03-04, provided the SSO and sample data timelines align.

Action items I'm assigning now:
- Ben Carter: own integration smoke test and deliver a pre-demo checklist by 2027-02-15. (Ben — will you confirm feasibility? We can tighten if Novamed expedites SSO creds.)
- Karthik Iyer: update the MAP spreadsheet with Option B + shifted test window (Karthik, please add a column for Novamed-verified ETA so we can track dependencies).
- Soojin Lee: validate the SOC 2 evidence list and call out any items we need to pull from our compliance pack.

Ben / Karthik / Soojin, please loop back with a short note (OK / need info / blocked) by end of day tomorrow so we can share an updated MAP with Novamed.

Avery / Jennifer — can you confirm the SAML attribute list and who on your SSO team we should contact? If it helps, I can paste our standard SAML attribute table into the MAP doc.

I will upload an updated MAP snapshot to the Drive once I have Ben / Karthik / Soojin's confirmations.

—
Marissa

Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Draft engagement calendar + dependency checklist

All — I can take the integration smoke test and hit the Feb dates with one caveat: we need either the SSO test creds or a test user pool and a 50–100 MB anonymized sample dataset by Jan 31. That gives my team two full weeks to run the smoke test and fix blockers before the Feb 15 pre-demo checklist deadline.

Proposed integration milestone (short):
- Jan 31: Novamed provides SAML test creds + sample dataset
- Feb 07: Integration smoke test complete (internal)
- Feb 15: Pre-demo checklist delivered to Novamed (includes test results + remediation plan)

I'll attach a short scope doc (integration-scope.md) with the endpoints we need and a minimal test plan. Karthik — once you update the MAP spreadsheet, I can paste the milestone rows into the doc so we have a single source of truth.

OK to proceed on my end.

—
